question: Why do shopping centers impose uniform sign criteria on tenants rather than letting each design freely?
summary: Derived sign criteria as a Coasean/commons-rationing response (shared facade, bounded attention, fixed municipal sign-area budget, anchor-tenant bargaining asymmetry) before searching; corpus confirms the practice (TDCM, two-layer private+municipal regulation, panel scarcity, anchor carve-outs) but states it as landlord doctrine rather than deriving the underlying economics.
